trusted_local_snapshot_probe.reproduction_source:
import json, os, pickle, random, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from address_segmentation import AddressMatcher
from address_segmentation.io import load_dictionary
from tools.datasets import load_cases
from tools.benchmark import measure_cli, compute_stats
folder = Path("reports/index-review")
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
data = load_dictionary("reports/scale/dictionary.json")
cases = load_cases("reports/scale/cases.jsonl", data)
matcher = AddressMatcher(**data)
artifact = folder / "trusted-local-experiment.pickle"
with artifact.open("wb") as stream:
    pickle.dump(matcher, stream, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL)
command = [sys.executable, "-c",
    "import json,pickle,sys; matcher=pickle.load(open(sys.argv[1],'rb')); "
    "address=json.loads(sys.stdin.readline()); "
    "print(json.dumps(matcher.identify(address),ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)",
    str(artifact)]
values = [measure_cli(command, [case.address], dict(os.environ), 30)[0]
          for case in random.Random(42).sample(cases, 20)]
print(artifact.stat().st_size, compute_stats(values))

limitations: Primary reports measure 20 unique seeded uniformly sampled cases repeated in five rounds (100 processes), not all 1,000 cases.
No cold-process warmups. OS page caches and Python bytecode caches are uncontrolled.
Before/after reports are sequential, not an interleaved experiment; machine load and scheduling can affect timings.
Construction caching benefits repeated vocabulary; the upcoming instructor dictionary may differ.
Startup probes emit a constant three-null result and do not load a dictionary or implement a matcher.
Serialization probe uses a locally generated trusted file; build/write is outside timing, loading is inside. It is not a supported artifact format.
No replacement compact queryable artifact implementation was benchmarked; no evidence of compliance with the 10 ms mean exists for this runtime.
Memory measurements run separately and RSS includes allocation tracing overhead.
Instructor environment, dictionary-delivery contract and exact CLI protocol remain unverified.
